title: Tropical City Heights
caption: Tall modern skyscrapers rise above colorful storefronts framed by lush green palm trees under clear skies.
alt: A low-angle view looking past green palm trees and a streetlamp toward tall modern skyscrapers under a clear blue sky.

title: FEB Campus Tower
caption: Curved campus road leads to tall FEB building surrounded by lush trees under sunny sky.
alt: A tall red-and-white FEB university tower rises behind lush green trees along a curved brick road under a clear blue sky with a lone motorcyclist riding away.

title: Brawijaya University Entrance
caption: The iconic clock tower and university sign at the entrance of Universitas Brawijaya campus.
alt: A paved road leads to the blue "Universitas Brawijaya" sign and a tall clock tower surrounded by lush trees under a clear sky.

title: Urban Oasis
caption: A peaceful lake reflects the clear sky, framed by lush trees and distant city towers.
alt: A calm lake sits before a distant city skyline, framed by overhanging tree branches and a small banana plant in the foreground.

title: Twin Cathedral Spires
caption: A neo-Gothic cathedral with twin spires rises quietly beneath a heavy overcast sky.
alt: A neo-Gothic cathedral with tall twin spires stands prominently under an overcast, moody sky framed by dark trees and a paved street.

title: Volcano Over Fields
caption: Lush green fields stretch toward a mosque with a volcano rising behind.
alt: Lush green rice fields stretch from a roadside marker toward a village mosque with a green dome, with a large conical volcano rising under a blue cloudy sky in the background.

title: Sunlit Yellow Roadster
caption: Yellow Porsche convertible parked on sunny tree-lined road near bird conservation sign.
alt: Bright yellow Porsche Boxster convertible parked on a sunlit asphalt road beside a green Indonesian conservation sign under trees.
